title: UPPSC GIC Lecturer Reccruitment 2025 Admit Card 2026 Out For 1518 Post
intro: Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission (UPPSC) has Officially Released Admit Card for the Post of Lecturer (GIC) in Government Inter College Recruitment 2025 for 1518 Post. Exam held On June 14 & 17, 2026 & Admit Card Available On June 4, 2026. All Interested Candidates Can Download Admit Card Now in The Given Link Below.
